+package config

+
+	// SUSEOpenstackCloud is
+	SUSEOpenstackCloud = "suse.openstack.cloud"
+
+	// Alpine is
+	Alpine = "alpine"
+)
+
+const (
+	// ServerTypePseudo is used for ServerInfo.Type, r.Family
+	ServerTypePseudo = "pseudo"
+)
+
+// EOL describes the lifecycle of an OS release. Ended reports whether all
+// applicable support has ended at lookup time. A zero extended date means
+// the vendor has not published an extended support phase for this release.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has passed its end date.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether extended support has passed its end date.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// supportDates is the authoritative lifecycle data. An empty second date means
+// that extended support does not apply.
+var supportDates = map[string]map[string][2]string{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   {"2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		"2 (Karoo)": {"2025-06-30", ""},
+	},
+	RedHat: {
+		"7": {"2024-06-30", ""}, "8": {"2029-05-31", ""},
+		"6": {"2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+	},
+	CentOS: {
+		"7": {"2024-06-30", ""}, "8": {"2021-12-31", ""},
+		"6": {"2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+	},
+	Oracle: {
+		"7": {"2024-06-30", ""}, "8": {"2029-05-31", ""},
+		"6": {"2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+	},
+	Ubuntu: {
+		"18.04": {"2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"},
+		"14.04": {"2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"},
+		"14.10": {"2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		"21.04": {"2022-01-30", ""},
+	},
+	Debian: {
+		"9": {"2022-06-30", ""}, "10": {"2024-06-30", ""},
+		"8": {"2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+	},
+	Alpine: {
+		"3.10": {"2021-05-30", ""},
+		"3.11": {"2021-11-30", ""},
+		"3.12": {"2022-05-30", ""},
+		"3.9":  {"2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+	},
+	FreeBSD: {
+		"11": {"2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+		"12": {"2023-12-31", ""},
+		"10": {"2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	},
+}
+
+// GetEOL retrieves lifecycle dates for an exact family and release identifier.
+func GetEOL(family string, release string) (EOL, bool) {
+	dates, ok := supportDates[family][release]
+	if !ok {
+		return EOL{}, false
+	}
+	standard, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[0])
+	var extended time.Time
+	if dates[1] != "" {
+		extended, _ = time.Parse("2006-01-02", dates[1])
+	}
+	finalSupportUntil := standard
+	if !extended.IsZero() {
+		finalSupportUntil = extended
+	}
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: standard, ExtendedSupportUntil: extended,
+		Ended: time.Now().After(finalSupportUntil)}, true
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestGetEOLExactMapping(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ family, release, standard, extended string }{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"},
+		{Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"},
+	} {
+		e, ok := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release)
+		if !ok || e.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.standard {
+			t.Errorf("missing or wrong standard date for %s %s: %+v", tc.family, tc.release, e)
+		}
+		if tc.extended == "" && !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() || tc.extended != "" && e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tc.extended {
+			t.Errorf("wrong extended date for %s %s", tc.family, tc.release)
+		}
+		if !e.IsStandardSupportEnded(e.StandardSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) || e.IsStandardSupportEnded(e.StandardSupportUntil) {
+			t.Errorf("wrong standard boundary for %s %s", tc.family, tc.release)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, tc := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}, {Amazon, "2 (Other)"}} {
+		if _, ok := GetEOL(tc.family, tc.release); ok {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected lifecycle for %s %s", tc.family, tc.release)
+		}
+	}
+}

+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the part of a version before its first dot, without an epoch.
+func Major(v string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(v, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		v = v[:i]
+	}
+	return v
+}

+++ b/scan/eol.go
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/util"
+)
+
+const eolDateFormat = "2006-01-02"
+
+// eolRelease selects the published release identifier from a detected OS
+// version. GetEOL itself accepts only identifiers in the lifecycle table.
+func eolRelease(family, release string) string {
+	switch family {
+	case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Oracle, config.Debian, config.FreeBSD:
+		return util.Major(release)
+	case config.Alpine:
+		parts := strings.Split(release, ".")
+		if len(parts) >= 2 {
+			return strings.Join(parts[:2], ".")
+		}
+	}
+	return release
+}
+
+func eolWarnings(family, release string, now time.Time) []string {
+	if family == config.ServerTypePseudo || family == config.Raspbian {
+		return nil
+	}
+	eol, found := config.GetEOL(family, eolRelease(family, release))
+	if !found {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", family, release)}
+	}
+	if eol.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		warnings := []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended."}
+		if !eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if eol.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				warnings = append(warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", eol.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format(eolDateFormat)))
+			}
+		}
+		return warnings
+	}
+	if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(eol.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		return []string{fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", eol.StandardSupportUntil.Format(eolDateFormat))}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package scan

+	"reflect"

+
+func TestEOLWarningsBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	date := func(s string) time.Time { v, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s); return v }
+	cases := []struct {
+		family, release string
+		now             time.Time
+		want            []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", date("2023-03-01"), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2023-05-31"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", date("2023-05-31"), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2023-05-31"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", date("2023-06-01"), []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site."}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", date("2015-07-31"), []string{"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.", "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended."}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "9", date("2025-01-01"), nil},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		got := eolWarnings(tc.family, tc.release, tc.now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s at %s: got %q, want %q", tc.family, tc.release, tc.now, got, tc.want)
